Name: Shemaiah, Priest Distributor
Summary: Shemaiah served with Kore in the cities of the priests, giving portions to his brethren by courses under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Shemaiah served with Kore in the cities of the priests, giving portions to his brethren by courses under Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: Kore, Son of Imnah; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Fair portions for every priest, great and small, came through faithful distributors.
